task:
Address all remaining substantive Codex findings on PR #576 in one bounded remediation. Target branch frontend/svelte-foundation and require exact starting head 93bf7bb01c96be6d5f2b2b4d2e9d2faaac2e8b24; fail closed if the branch moved. The earlier P1 formatting finding is already resolved and must not be reworked. Fix these four P2 findings only, while preserving the declared foundation scope (no production deployment, no backend behavior change, no React removal, no Babylon/Stage 27 expansion, no dependency/version churn unless absolutely required and justified).

1) Make the real FastAPI OpenAPI contract authoritative for the Svelte Hey API client. The current apps/web/openapi/bootstrap.openapi.json is hand-maintained and must no longer be the generation authority; preferably remove it entirely if nothing needs it. Change apps/web/openapi-ts.config.ts / generation plumbing so generation takes an explicit environment-provided OpenAPI input (URL or path) and has NO hand-maintained schema fallback. Do not change FastAPI operation_ids merely to preserve bootstrap-generated SDK names; regenerate from the real backend contract and adapt the stable handwritten apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts wrapper and its tests to whatever Hey API operation names the real schema produces, while keeping the application-facing getHealth/getAuthSession API stable. Extend the existing authoritative OpenAPI drift lane in .github/workflows/ci.yml: it already boots a disposable FastAPI instance and regenerates frontend/src/types/api.gen.ts from http://127.0.0.1:8000/openapi.json. In that SAME job, after the API is healthy, set up the locked Node 24 / pnpm 11.25.0 Svelte environment, install apps/web with --frozen-lockfile, generate the Svelte Hey API client from that exact running /openapi.json, and fail on git drift under apps/web/src/lib/api/generated. The ordinary Svelte web job must not try to regenerate from a static bootstrap schema; it should still check/type/lint/format/test/build the checked-in generated client. Also extend scripts/checks/openapi-drift.sh so its local/disposable live FastAPI OpenAPI check regenerates and drift-checks BOTH the retained React client and apps/web generated Hey API client from the SAME OPENAPI_URL. Keep the script's existing safe-DB protections. Update repository contract tests so they prove Svelte generation is tied to the live/backend OpenAPI lane and cannot silently fall back to a checked-in bootstrap schema. If useful, document the explicit generation env var briefly, but do not broaden docs.

2) Reject unknown journey route parameters. The only valid Svelte journey paths are explore, inspect, plan, review. Use a canonical SvelteKit route matcher or load-time 404 validation so URLs such as /explroe and /admin do NOT render the migration placeholder as if valid. Preserve the four valid journey pages and direct-refresh behavior. Add focused unit/route tests and browser coverage for at least one unknown route showing a not-found result rather than the migration placeholder.

3) Proxy every backend-owned same-origin route in BOTH Vite dev and preview. Preserve /api proxying, add exact /openapi.json, and proxy ONLY numeric share paths matching /s/{id64} (do not proxy arbitrary /s/*). Factor the proxy config cleanly so server and preview cannot drift. Add Cypress proof against the real disposable API used by the existing Svelte Cypress workflow: /openapi.json must return the FastAPI schema (for example it contains /api/health), and /s/0 with failOnStatusCode false must demonstrate FastAPI ownership (expected FastAPI JSON 404 / application-json rather than Svelte HTML/fallback). Do not depend on a production system id.

4) Strengthen the existing bootstrap Cypress smoke. After the real /api/health and /api/auth/session 200 responses, assert that the rendered status panel reaches Connected and Guest so the test covers generated SDK parsing + TanStack Query + UI rendering, not merely proxy HTTP status.

Validation: run the focused Python repository contracts including tests/test_svelte_web_foundation_contract.py and tests/test_v3_application_stack_decision.py. In apps/web run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm check, pnpm lint, pnpm format:check, pnpm test, and pnpm build. For generation validation, use the actual FastAPI app OpenAPI output (app.openapi() written to a temporary schema is acceptable inside the worker if a disposable DB/API service is unavailable) and prove Hey API generation succeeds and the checked-in generated tree matches; CI/local drift authority itself must use the live running /openapi.json as described above. Run shell syntax/targeted contract validation for scripts/checks/openapi-drift.sh and CI YAML/contract tests. Update Cypress tests/config as needed but do not weaken the protected Cypress authority. Commit and push only this bounded remediation through the worker's trusted exact-head mechanism.
